steps.reasoning: We need to describe fields of K8SNode. Use describe_model tool.

steps.text:
**K8SNode model fields**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| **name** | string | Primary key; the node’s unique identifier within the cluster. |
| **status** | string | Current operational status (e.g., Ready, NotReady, Unknown). |
| **roles** | string | Comma‑separated list of the node’s roles (e.g., master, worker). |
| **age** | string | How long the node has been part of the cluster (e.g., “5d12h”). |
| **version** | string | Kubernetes version running on the node (e.g., “v1.27.3”). |
| **internalIp** | string | The node’s internal IP address used for cluster communication. |
| **osImage** | string | Operating system image name (e.g., “Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS”). |
| **kernelVersion** | string | Kernel version of the node’s OS. |
| **containerRuntime** | string | Container runtime in use (e.g., “docker://20.10.24”). |
| **clusterName** | string | Name of the Kubernetes cluster the node belongs to. |

The **primary key** for this model is **name**. Use these fields when querying or updating K8SNode records.
